content:
In addition to releasing the first public beta of iPadOS 27 and macOS 27 Golden Gate, Apple also simultaneously launched a new version of the developer beta. Here are the relevant details.

New revised version released alongside the public beta

Along with the launch of the first public beta, Apple also released the revised third-round developer beta of iPadOS 27 and macOS 27 Golden Gate at the same time.

The revised third-round iPadOS 27 developer beta carries the build number 24A5380l, while the updated third-round macOS 27 Golden Gate beta carries the build number 26A5378n.

It remains unclear why Apple has released a revised version, as no widespread reports of major issues had surfaced with the previous build. The new version may have been issued to address issues discovered prior to today's release of the public beta, though Apple has not provided any details.

That said, we are working hard to dig through these new releases and will report back if we find anything noteworthy.

Have you spotted anything new in the revised version? Let us know in the comments.
